Retained explicit open commitment: Act is simply prior to potency: whatever is in potency in a respect is simply posterior to some being that is in act in that respect. Exact applications are bound by the scoped Challenges. Existing source/attempt evidence is reused, not a renewed source-fidelity certification.

Retained explicit open commitment: Nothing has actuality except insofar as it is: whatever is in act in some respect has being. Exact applications are bound by the scoped Challenges. Existing source/attempt evidence is reused, not a renewed source-fidelity certification.

Reused intermediate, not admitted as a new external premise: There is at most one maximum in being: any two beings that are each maximal in being (each has being, and nothing is more a being than either) are the same. Exact applications are bound by the scoped Challenges. Existing source/attempt evidence is reused, not a renewed source-fidelity certification.

Retained explicit open commitment: Open premise: the cause of a thing's being causes each of its perfections. If c causes x's being and x is in act in some respect, c causes x's being in act in that respect. Exact applications are bound by the scoped Challenges. Existing source/attempt evidence is reused, not a renewed source-fidelity certification.

Unrestricted strict causal ascent remains an unattributed open strengthening. Reuse previous synonymous-cause audit and rejection of silently dropping synonymy/ties. It is neither sourced anew nor discharged by this migration.

Open one-way law on the exact nine specialized predicates at one g. IsImmutable receives InPotency, never InAct. Checked classicalAttributesSuffice_iff preserves the original curried law; HasClassicalAttributes remains primitive with no recovery converse.

Retained explicit open commitment: Every agent other than God whose being God causes is, whenever it moves something, itself moved in some respect. Read from q.105 a.5: every created agent acts in virtue of God, who applies its form and powers to operation, besides giving and preserving them. That its mover is God, and God's applying its powers, are not formalized. Exact applications are bound by the scoped Challenges. Existing source/attempt evidence is reused, not a renewed source-fidelity certification.

Retained explicit open commitment: Open premise, the fuller nominal definition: the name 'God' applies, in its proper sense, to the only being that is maximal in being (above all), causes the being of every other being (principle of all), causes every perfection of every other being (cause of every perfection, et hoc dicimus Deum), and enters into the composition of nothing (remote from all, q.13 a.8 ad 2). It keeps every condition the sources give, so it is weaker than STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS. Exact applications are bound by the scoped Challenges. Retained declared step: If one maximum in being were other than another, the other, being maximal, would cause its being (genus principle at esse), and so be more a being than it (Metaphysics II.1); but nothing is more a being than a maximum. So the two are not distinct, and by excluded middle they are the same. Ordered instantiation and same-witness binding checked in the selected theorem types; this does not establish the open inputs.

Existing interpretation retained: `InAct x r`: x actually has the perfection r, as fire is actually hot. In Lean `InAct` is a parameter, not a definition: its content is fixed only by the premises that use it, above all that nothing is in act and in potency in the same respect at once. Whether a mover must have the perfection formally or may have it virtually is left open (DISAMB-IN-ACT). No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: x is altogether immaterial when it is neither composed of matter and form (`¬ ComposedOfMatterAndForm x`) nor a component of anything, as matter or as a form in matter (`∀ y, ¬ ComponentOf x y`, which is DEF-REMOTE-FROM-ALL). This is the grade of immateriality that ST I q.14 a.1 makes the reason of intellectual knowledge: the mode of knowledge follows the mode of immateriality, and what is in the highest degree immaterial is in the highest degree of knowledge. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: The root STMT-CATHOLICISM-TRUE means exactly: (A) the Catholic Church is a teaching authority founded by God (`IsGod`; no uniqueness asserted), and (B) the twelve articles of the Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed hold. It does not yet include the full list of defined dogmas. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: `CausesIn c x r`: c is a cause of x's being r, as fire is a cause of the heat of hot things. It is not identified with moving (`MovesIn`): causing a perfection need not be a present reduction from potency to act. 'Cause of being' is the instance r = esse. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: The case groups simple, perfect, good, one, infinite, immutable, eternal, intellect and will in the order of ClassicalAttributesSuffice. In the complete stage-2 composition its arguments are IsSimple Composite (DEF-SIMPLE), IsPerfect InAct (DEF-UNIVERSALLY-PERFECT), IsSupremelyGood InAct GoodIn CausesIn esse (DEF-SUPREMELY-GOOD), IsTheOneGod σ.IsGod (DEF-ONE-GOD), Infinite (DEF-INFINITE), IsImmutable InPotency (DEF-IMMUTABLE), Eternal (DEF-ETERNAL), HasIntellect (DEF-HAS-INTELLECT), and HasWill (DEF-HAS-WILL). No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: A Church proposal that a proposition is to be believed as divinely revealed, made by solemn judgment or by the ordinary and universal magisterium. This is the proposal condition in Dei Filius ch. 3, paragraph 4, not an arbitrary assertion by Church members or authorities. The source's rule for divine and catholic faith separately requires that the content be contained in the word of God written or handed down; the act of proposing it does not by definition establish that separate condition or its truth. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: The distinguished respect `esse`: `InAct x esse` says that x has being. Esse is the actuality of all things, even of forms: nothing has actuality except insofar as it is. Being 'maximal in being' and 'cause of being' are said with respect to this respect. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Essence is what a thing is, its nature or quiddity, contrasted with its act of being (esse). The statement that God is his own esse identifies these in its theological context; the words essence and esse alone do not make that identity hold. This sense is not Scott’s modal essence of an individual or the 1970 Gödel variant’s different essence definition. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Eternity has neither beginning nor end and is without succession, all at once (ST I q.10 a.1); it is not merely endless time. In stage 2 Eternal is a primitive predicate supplied to GodIsEternal and ClassicalAttributesSuffice. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.
Existing interpretation retained: `IsFirstBeing f`: no being other than f is simply prior to f. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: `IsFirstUnmovedMover f`: f moves something and is itself moved in no respect. 'A nullo movetur' is read as 'moved in no respect', not 'not moved by anything else'. The definition does not make f God, unique, or pure act; those are separate statements. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: The index `r : Respect` of the quarta via's genus principle (`MaximumInGenusCausesAllInGenusReading`): a perfection such as heat, goodness or being, whose bearers are more and less such by approach to what is maximally such. It need not be a strict genus: heat in the example is a quality, not a genus of hot things, and being is not a strict genus. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: The Lean parameter `God : Being → Prop` of the stage-1 maxime ens route: g is the one the Summa calls God (q.105 a.5, q.13 a.8). Its content comes only from the premises that use it. The open premise STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS gives a sufficient condition for it, a reduced form of the q.13 nominal definition (the only maximum in being that causes the being of every other being), which drops 'remote from all' and the causation of goodness and every perfection. On that route it is a different parameter from `IsGod`. The designated route (CATHOLICISM-STAGE1-VIA-FULL-DESCRIPTION) does not use this parameter: its fuller nominal premise STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE applies the name to `IsGod` directly (DISAMB-GOD). No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: What the name 'God' is imposed to signify: something existing above all, which is the principle of all and remote from all (supra omnia existens, quod est principium omnium, et remotum ab omnibus). A nominal definition: what the name signifies, not what God is. Kept whole, with all three conditions. The fuller nominal premise STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE formalizes it, together with the quarta via's 'cause of every perfection', reading 'remote from all' as DEF-REMOTE-FROM-ALL. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: The case signature's `IsGod g`: g is God in the sense of the God of classical theism, not merely what is called God. The stages after stage 1 and the root use this predicate. Its content is fixed only by the open premises that use it: STMT-GOD-HAS-CLASSICAL-DIVINE-ATTRIBUTES (simple, perfect, good, infinite, immutable, eternal, one, with intellect and will) and, on the older stage-1 routes, the identification premise STMT-UNIQUE-PURE-ACT-FIRST-MOVER-IS-GOD. On the designated route it is also fixed by the fuller nominal premise STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE, which applies the proper name 'God' to `IsGod` directly (DISAMB-GOD). The individual attribute senses and their one-way mapping to the skeleton field are recorded in DEF-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-BUNDLE and linked from STMT-GOD-HAS-CLASSICAL-DIVINE-ATTRIBUTES. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Good and being are the same in reality and differ only in notion: a thing is good in a respect exactly insofar as it is in act in that perfection; good adds the notion of the desirable. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Having intellect means intellectual cognition, distinguished from sense in ST I q.14 a.1 by its greater separation from matter. Cognition involves the form of what is known in the knower; divine cognition is not a created habit or quality. HasIntellect remains a primitive predicate of beings in GodHasIntellect and ClassicalAttributesSuffice. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Will is the inclination of an intellectual nature toward the good apprehended through an intelligible form: seeking it when absent and resting in it when possessed (ST I q.19 a.1). Divine will is not a lack seeking satisfaction: Aquinas says it always possesses its good. HasWill is a primitive predicate in GodHasWill and ClassicalAttributesSuffice. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Altogether immutable means incapable of any change, not merely unchanging now (ST I q.9 a.1). The first argument excludes change because the first being has no potency, and whatever changes is in some way in potency. Stage 2 uses IsImmutable InPotency g := ∀ r, ¬ InPotency g r. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: A cause is in act formally in a perfection when it has that perfection in the same form in which it produces it, as fire that is hot makes the wood hot. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: A cause is in act virtually, or eminently, in a perfection when it has it in a higher way, as a power to produce it, without having it in the same form: whatever perfection is in the effect is in the effective cause 'univocally or more eminently' (ST I q.4 a.2). No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Divine infinity is unboundedness of subsistent being not received in, and limited by, anything (ST I q.7 a.1). It is the infinity of perfection, not an infinite quantity or indeterminate matter. Infinite is a primitive predicate supplied to GodIsInfinite and to ClassicalAttributesSuffice. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: The maximum in being: `IsMaximumIn InAct MoreIn esse m`, that is, m has being and nothing is more a being than m. Reached in the quarta via from the maximally true (quae sunt maxime vera, sunt maxime entia). Uniqueness is not part of the definition; it is the derived statement STMT-AT-MOST-ONE-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: `IsMaximumIn InAct MoreIn r m`: m has the perfection r and nothing is more r than m. Maximal, not greatest: it does not say that m is more r than everything else, so it does not by itself give uniqueness. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: `MoreIn r x y`: x is more r than y (more good, more true, more noble, more hot). Only the comparative is primitive: nothing makes it a total order, a measure, or comparable across all things. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: To move is nothing other than to educe something from potency to act. `MovedIn x r`: x is being reduced from potency to act in respect r; `MovesIn y x r`: y so reduces x. Read at one time (simul): a present series of movers, not a history. Nothing restricts it to local motion or to bodies. Aristotle's definition of motion as the actuality of the potential as such, read for beings and respects (STMT-BEING-MOVED-IS-ACTUALIZATION-OF-POTENCY), would make STMT-NOTHING-MOVED-EXCEPT-AS-IN-POTENCY analytic if adopted as the Lean definition of `MovedIn`; it is no stronger than that premise (result ACT-POTENCY-DEFINITIONAL-ANALYSES-CONSERVATIVE), so `MovedIn` stays a parameter. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: What a name signifies, as opposed to what the thing is (quod quid est). In demonstrating from an effect that a cause exists, the middle term is what the name signifies, because the question what it is follows the question whether it is; the names of God are imposed from his effects. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: One God is numerical uniqueness of the God confessed by Dei Filius ch. 1. The case uses IsTheOneGod IsGod g := ∀ g′, IsGod g′ → g′ = g. This predicate alone does not assert IsGod g or the existence of any God; those are separate premises or conclusions. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Truth said of a thing is its conformity to the intellect on which it depends in being, rather than its being believed or observed. In ST I q.16 a.1, a true artifact realizes the form conceived by its maker, and a true natural thing realizes its proper nature according to the divine intellect’s exemplar (a true stone has the nature proper to a stone). This truth is secondary to truth in intellect. ST I q.16 a.3 relates a thing’s intelligibility to the being it has: truth adds a relation to intellect to the account of being. This is the ontological sense used to interpret the quarta via’s verum, not sentence truth, confidence, or frequency of endorsement. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: For this reading, x is more true than y in the relevant respect when x more fully realizes the intelligible nature or form under consideration: the comparison is of realization of that form, hence of intelligibility grounded in actuality. It is not a comparison of two sentences’ accuracy, how many observers agree, or an observer’s certainty. The relevant form and comparative must be supplied by an interpretation of the things compared; no numerical measure or total comparability of all kinds is stipulated. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Every mover other than the moved thing that is itself being moved, in any respect, moves only insofar as it is moved. This is reading A of 'moventia secunda non movent nisi per hoc quod sunt mota a primo movente', and the reading the case uses. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: A series in which each cause after the first causes only insofar as it is, here and now, moved by the one before it: the stone is moved by the stick, the stick by the hand. In Lean the link is `MovesAsMoved y x` (y moves x only insofar as y is itself moved) and 'no infinite regress' is well-foundedness of that relation (`NoInfinitePerSeMoverSeriesReading`). No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: `InPotency x r`: x is in potency to r, able to be r without being r actually; what is actually hot is at the same time cold in potency. A parameter in Lean, constrained by the same premises as `InAct`; nothing defines it as the negation of act. That gloss, 'able to be r without being r actually', is the Metaphysics IX.6 analysis (STMT-POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY). If it were made the Lean definition of `InPotency`, STMT-NOTHING-IN-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT would become analytic; the analysis is satisfiable exactly when that premise holds (result ACT-POTENCY-DEFINITIONAL-ANALYSES-CONSERVATIVE), so this would move the premise's openness to the analysis's fidelity without discharging it. `InPotency` therefore stays a parameter. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: `PureAct f`: f is in potency in no respect (nullo modo in potentia; q.3 a.2: purus actus, non habens aliquid de potentialitate). No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: The existing essenceOf map is used in the Thomistic nature/quiddity sense. The Principle parameter deity represents the divine nature considered in q.11 a.3’s first proof. ProperGodInstancesHaveCommonNatureReading explicitly says that every original IsGod instance has essenceOf g = deity. This is a qualified shared-nature reading of the hypothetical plurality, not a definitional membership test for IsGod, a genus, or the conclusion of numerical uniqueness. Equality here is equality of represented nature values, not merely two beings falling under the same word or predicate. Mere univocal use of God does not establish this premise; accepting the shared-nature reading remains a substantive interpretive commitment. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: For a being g satisfying the original IsGod predicate, suppositumOf g = essenceOf g in the existing Principle sort. This represents q.3 a.3’s absence of a real suppositum/nature distinction for God. It is an explicit universal open commitment, not a definition of IsGod or a theorem inferred from generic simplicity. It does not equate Lean objects in Being with objects in Principle. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: The Principle-valued representation suppositumOf x records that by which a singular being is this individual, in q.11 a.3 first proof. It is distinguished from the nature essenceOf x. Equality of represented bases entails identity of beings only under STMT-Q11-INDIVIDUATING-BASIS-INCOMMUNICABLE; no injectivity, existence or God-uniqueness is built into the map. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: `RemoteFromAll ComponentOf m`: m enters into the composition of nothing, as neither part, matter nor form of anything (`∀ x, ¬ ComponentOf m x`). This is the case's reading of the third condition in q.13 a.8 ad 2's description of what the name 'God' signifies, taken through q.3 a.8, the article that denies God any composition with other things. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: `Respect`: that with respect to which a thing is moved, in act or in potency, such as being hot. The quarta via reads a respect as a perfection (ST I q.4 a.1: a thing is called perfect insofar as it is in act). 'Moved in no respect' quantifies over all respects. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: A statement is self-evident in this corpus when its record carries a `self_evident` marking whose justification ids are sourced claims or results: the marking is itself a challengeable, argued claim, not a bare flag. It names a floor basis (retorsion, common_ground or observation) and closes the statement only while that criterion holds on the current records; closure is relative to the listed bases (docs/corpus-model.md, #500). No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Simple means without composition of any kind (ST I q.3 a.7), including quantitative parts, matter/form, nature/suppositum, essence/being, genus/difference and subject/accident. The case encodes this as IsSimple Composite g := ¬ Composite g. Composite is a primitive covering every relevant composition; the predicate is not merely the denial of matter-form composition. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: `PriorSimply y x`: y is prior to x simply, not in time: whatever is in potency in a respect presupposes some being in act in that respect, because potency is reduced to act only by a being in act. It is a dependence relation distinct from present moving. Whether simple priority makes y a cause of x's being is not part of this definition: that is the open premise STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: The skeleton separately assumes that God can reveal recognizably through external signs (motives of credibility), that Jesus claimed to speak and act with divine authority and rose, that Christ founded a visible, enduring Church with an authority structure, and that each society he so founded is the Catholic Church. Society equality represents the latter historical-identity claim. These are the advertised meanings of distinct primitive fields/relations in Signature, not definitions that make any of them hold. Founding a society is distinct from founding it as a teaching authority, and Jesus’s stage predicate RoseFromTheDead is not identified with the separate uninterpreted Creed article. The phase-1 root fixes the teaching-authority role and twelve Creed articles. No event criteria, complete ecclesiology or evidence for those assumptions is supplied by the signature. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Supreme goodness is goodness in the most excellent mode, as the first, non-univocal cause from which all desired perfections flow (ST I q.6 a.2). Goodness itself adds desirability to being in act (DEF-GOOD-AS-BEING-IN-ACT). The case predicate IsSupremelyGood is the conjunction GoodIn g esse and CausesEveryPerfectionOfOthers InAct CausesIn g (DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION). No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: UniqueClassicalGodExists σ means ∃g, σ.IsGod g ∧ IsTheOneGod σ.IsGod g ∧ σ.HasClassicalAttributes g. Every conjunct concerns the same g. IsTheOneGod quantifies over all beings satisfying the original σ.IsGod, not only maximal beings. No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing interpretation retained: Universally perfect means lacking none of the perfections found in things (ST I q.4 a.2). These preexist in God eminently, not as a conjunction of incompatible creaturely forms. IsPerfect InAct g := ∀ x r, InAct x r → InAct g r uses InAct in its formal-or-virtual sense (DEF-IN-ACT-FORMALLY, DEF-IN-ACT-VIRTUALLY). No new structural law, source attribution or independently established premise is introduced.

Existing resolution retained: The old HasWill predicate and q.80 appetitive-power reading concern having a power/nature, while seeking, loving, delighting and communicating are described acts. No current act follows from a primitive power label alone. Seeking absent good is not required for willing; no dormant or passive state is attributed to God by this contrast.

Existing resolution retained: Aquinas draws this distinction himself (ST I q.48 a.2 ad 2). Stage 1 uses only being as the entity of a thing: the domain `Being`, the respect `esse` (DEF-ESSE) and 'maximal in being'. Being as the truth of a proposition appears only in STMT-EVIL-IS-AS-PROPOSITIONAL-TRUTH, where 'there is evil' is the truth (`Holds`) of a sentence. Sentences and beings are different Lean types, so no result can pass from 'evil is' to 'evil is a being' or count a privation as in act with respect to esse. What the definitions do not settle is whether being admits of more and less (`MoreIn esse`) across categories; that is carried by the premises that use the primitive comparative (STMT-GRADES-HAVE-A-MAXIMUM, STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING), not by the word. Aristotle's many senses of being (STMT-BEING-HAS-SEVERAL-SENSES) are senses of being as entity. Whether being is said univocally or analogically, and so whether it is a genus, is a separate axis recorded in DISAMB-BEING-UNIVOCITY and DISAMB-GENUS.

Existing resolution retained: The sources read here take being analogically: Aristotle's pros hen (STMT-BEING-SAID-PROS-HEN), Aquinas' analogy of divine names (STMT-DIVINE-NAMES-ANALOGICAL), being as the first analogical predicate (STMT-BEING-FIRST-ANALOGICAL-PREDICATE), and grades of being by approach to God (STMT-BEING-MEASURED-BY-APPROACH-TO-GOD). The quarta via premises that speak of more and less in being (STMT-GRADES-HAVE-A-MAXIMUM, STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING, STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS) are to be read in this analogical sense. Their Lean form does not encode it: `MoreIn esse` is a primitive comparative compatible with both senses. The two senses now have order models (DEF-HOMOGENEOUS-SCALE for the univocal sense, DEF-ORDER-BY-APPROACH-TO-A-PRIMARY for attribution), and DISAMB-ORDER-OF-BEING records, premise by premise, which survive on which model. The source-bound STMT-SYNONYMOUS-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IS-AT-LEAST-AS-SUCH requires a shared defining account (DEF-SHARED-DEFINING-ACCOUNT); STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH drops that condition and remains an unattributed open premise; STMT-SYNONYMOUS-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IS-MORE-SUCH retains the condition but adds strict superiority and likewise remains unattributed. Applying either to analogical being needs independent justification; analogy and failure of a shared account are not identified. The attribution-order result STMT-ATTRIBUTION-ORDER-RESTRICTS-CAUSE-MORE-SUCH derives a primary-as-cause comparison under strict primacy and gives a countermodel to unrestricted comparison; it does not establish synonymy or source the unrestricted use with the primary as effect in AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-FIRST-MOVER-IS-FIRST-BEING.

Existing resolution retained: The no-regress premise STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-MOVER-SERIES is stated only for per se links (`MovesAsMoved`); nothing on the root path says that a per accidens series must end. ST I q.46 a.2 ad 7 grants that a per accidens series (an infinite past of fathers or hammers) is not impossible (STMT-INFINITE-REGRESS-IMPOSSIBLE-ONLY-IN-PER-SE-SERIES), so an eternal world does not touch the prima via. The series is per se because of STMT-SECOND-MOVERS-MOVE-ONLY-AS-MOVED, and it is read at one time (simul). The secunda via has its own per se link between efficient causes, `CausesAsCaused` (DEF-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-LINK), with its own no-regress premise STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-SERIES. It is not identified with `MovesAsMoved`: the only passage from one to the other is the explicit premise STMT-PER-SE-MOVER-LINK-IS-PER-SE-CAUSE-LINK (q.46 a.2 ad 7, the stone, stick and hand), from which AQUINAS-ST-I-Q46-A2-AD7-MOVER-REGRESS-FROM-CAUSE-REGRESS derives the mover regress premise.

Existing resolution retained: The case keeps moving (`MovesIn`, a present reduction from potency to act), causing a perfection (`CausesIn`, with 'cause of being' at esse) and simple priority (`PriorSimply`, DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY) as separate predicates, and every passage between them is an explicit premise: STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING (open, bare) from simple priority to cause of being; STMT-EVERY-CREATED-AGENT-ACTS-AS-APPLIED-TO-ACT-BY-GOD (sourced, q.105 a.5: an agent whose being God causes is itself moved when it moves) linking causing being and moving; STMT-DIRECTING-IS-MOVING for the quinta via. Aristotle's four modes classify causes in general and are not premises of the root path. SCG I.13’s cause of coming to be (CausesOrigin) is recorded separately from moving in a respect or causing a perfection; the finite-past result does not identify its cause as God.

Existing resolution retained: Read q.80 passive appetite in its soul-power context; read q.19 divine willing with its identity with divine being and denial of external motion. The source analogy of inclination does not transfer creaturely passivity, appetite as a distinct accidental faculty, or transition to act into God. HasWill remains the existing primitive predicate, with no new equivalence definition.

Existing resolution retained: Scott's variant and Gödel's 1970 variant define 'essence' differently, and their statements and results keep the two apart. Scott's ess (DEF-ESSENCE-SCOTT) requires the bearer to have the essence, and its inclusion quantifies over all individuals; Gödel's 1970 Ess. (DEF-ESSENCE-GOEDEL-1970) drops that conjunct and quantifies over existing individuals. They are separate Lean declarations, `TruthCore.Isabelle.AFP.GoedelGod.Essence` and `TruthCore.Isabelle.AFP.NotesOnGoedel.GoedelVariantHOML1.Essence`, and no statement treats one as the other. The difference is what the paired results SCOTT-EMPTY-PROPERTY-NOT-ESSENCE and GOEDEL-1970-EMPTY-PROPERTY-IS-ESSENCE show, and it is what makes the 1970 axioms inconsistent (GOEDEL-1970-INCONSISTENT) while Scott's are satisfiable. Neither is the Thomist essence. Thomistic essence as nature/quiddity in the attribute readings is distinct from either modal essence definition; the claim of identity with esse is separate from this term’s definition. `FilteredEssence` (DEF-FILTERED-ESSENCE) is a stipulated experiment that filters comparison properties in Scott's structure; it neither changes the original Scott definition nor supplies an historical or metaphysical theory of essence.

Existing resolution retained: The bundle and ImmutableIsEternalReading intend timeless eternity, without beginning, end or succession. Endless succession is a contrast sense only. The existing Lean predicate Eternal is primitive and its sufficient condition does not encode or prove a temporal model.

Existing resolution retained: Aristotle's being-not-a-genus argument (ARIST-MET-998B-BEING-NOT-A-GENUS) and Aquinas' ST I q.3 a.5 (STMT-GOD-IN-NO-GENUS) use the strict sense only. The quarta via's genus principle (STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS, claim AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-MAXIMUM-CAUSES-GENUS-A) is read in the broad sense: its example is heat, which is a quality and not a strict genus of hot things; it is applied to being, which Aquinas himself says is no genus; and Aquinas' own account of grades of being (q.3 a.5 ad 2: each thing has as much of being as it approaches God) needs no common genus. Aristotle's 999a6-14 (STMT-NO-GENUS-OVER-PRIOR-AND-POSTERIOR) points the same way: an order of better and worse is not a strict genus. The strict reading of the quarta via sentence is rejected as Aquinas' meaning for these reasons, but kept as a formal contrast (`MaximumInStrictGenusCausesAllInGenusReading`): on it the via fails at being (STMT-STRICT-GENUS-READING-DOES-NOT-YIELD-QUARTA-VIA). On the broad reading, being-not-a-genus does not refute the premise (STMT-BROAD-GENUS-READING-COMPATIBLE-WITH-BEING-NOT-A-GENUS). No argument passes between the senses: the strict results speak of `IsGenus`, the broad premise quantifies over every respect and never mentions `IsGenus`. What the broad reading does not settle is whether the genus principle is true for being; that is the open premise itself, now without the equivocation objection.

Repaired an overgeneral same-witness note: original consumers retain the God-to-maximality premise, while Q11-NATURE uses three explicit nature/individuation premises instead. Local Maximal never redefines σ.IsGod. All theorem types and source readings unchanged.

Existing resolution retained: GoodIn on beings/perfections is actuality in the q.5 reading; GoodAct on acts is the practical-good predicate in q.94’s first precept. CatholicNaturalLaw conjoins these commitments but contains no identification or derivation of the latter predicate from the former.

Existing resolution retained: The complete stage-2 argument uses IsImmutable, meaning no potency in any respect. Merely not changing now cannot substitute for that antecedent in the eternity argument. The earlier GodIsImmutable wrapper accepts a primitive predicate, so its intended reading must be fixed separately.

Existing resolution retained: The case does not choose between the two senses. Every premise that speaks of act (STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-EXCEPT-AS-IN-ACT, STMT-NOTHING-IN-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT, STMT-PLURAL-FIRST-MOVERS-WOULD-DIFFER-IN-ACT, STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING, STMT-FIRST-UNMOVED-MOVER-HAS-EVERY-PERFECTION) uses the one parameter `InAct`, so within a result every premise is read in the same sense and no step passes from one sense to the other. The choice matters for premise truth, not validity: read formally, 'a thing moves only as in act' faces causes that produce what they do not themselves have; read virtually, the non-simultaneity premise must hold for virtual act too. A defence of these premises must fix one sense and defend all of them in it. BRIDGE-ARIST-POTENCY-ANALYSIS-NON-SIMULTANEITY reads the Metaphysics IX.6 analysis (STMT-POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY) with the same `InAct` as the non-simultaneity premise, so no step changes sense. IX.6 says 'not actually r' of formal act; read virtually, the analysis would say that potency to r excludes virtual act of r, a stronger reading than IX.6 states. The bridge therefore carries Aristotle's support to the premise on the formal reading only. STMT-PERFECT-INSOFAR-AS-IN-ACT, through which AQUINAS-ST-I-Q5-A1-GOODNESS-FROM-DESIRABILITY derives STMT-GOODNESS-IS-ACTUALITY, uses the one parameter `Has` of the conclusion, which the case instantiates by `InAct`; so the goodness steps take whatever sense the other act premises of a result take. ST I q.4 a.1 co. and q.5 a.1 co. speak of a thing's own act, so their support is for the formal reading.

Existing resolution retained: The classical-attributes bundle uses the infinity of unreceived subsistent being, not unlimited quantity or indeterminate matter. Infinite remains an abstract Lean predicate constrained by an explicit sufficient-condition premise; no theorem establishes quantitative infinity.

Existing resolution retained: HasIntellect means intellectual cognition, not any cognition whatever. The source distinguishes sense from intellect; the case’s sufficiency premise for intellect uses the stated interpretation of highest immateriality. Neither the primitive predicate nor this terminology proves an intellectual faculty from sensory awareness alone.

Existing resolution retained: The case uses the weakest sense: maximal in being, nothing being more a being (`IsMaximumIn InAct MoreIn esse`). It does not assume a strict maximum that exceeds every other being, and it does not use Anselm's conceptual description. Uniqueness is derived (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-AT-MOST-ONE-MAXIME-ENS), not built in. A reviewer who reads 'maxime ens' as 'the greatest possible being' is reading a stronger sense than any premise asserts.

Existing resolution retained: The prima via itself defines moving as educing from potency to act (claim AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-REDUCED-BY-A-MOVER-A), and the case reads motus in that broad sense. Aristotle's physical change is one kind of such reduction, so the observation premise STMT-SOMETHING-IS-MOVED-IN-THIS-WORLD holds on either reading. All premises share `MovedIn`/`MovesIn` over an abstract `Respect`, so the formal results hold for any one reading applied throughout; an objection that the regress premises hold only for local motion is an objection to a premise, not an equivocation. Scope (#404): the typed Physics readings (TruthCore.Greek.Aristotle.Physics.Typed, docs/typed-physics.md) read `MovedIn`/`MovesIn` as physical motion. A universal prima via premise restricts to physical motion, so results that use prima via premises to derive typed Physics statements stay within one reading. The converse does not hold: Physics premises about physical motion do not extend to every reduction from potency to act. VIII.4's division and its conclusions therefore carry an explicit guard for respects of physical motion (`IsPhysicalRespect`, DEF-PHYSICAL-RESPECT); its other readings are scoped by their antecedent primitives (forced, natural, self-, passive natural motion are kinds of physical motion by definition); the III.3 and VIII.5 readings carry no guard and are accepted only under a physical instantiation of `MovedIn`/`MovesIn`. The VIII.4 readings yield STMT-EVERY-PHYSICAL-MOTION-HAS-A-PER-SE-MOVER. They reach the root premise STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-MOVER only through the explicit, unattributed scope premise STMT-EVERY-REDUCTION-TO-ACT-IS-PHYSICAL-MOTION (result ARIST-PHYS-VIII-4-SCOPE-BRIDGE-TO-PRIMA-VIA), which is open and false on the broad reading if some reduction is not a physical motion. BRIDGE-ARIST-MOTION-ANALYSIS-MOVED-AS-IN-POTENCY reads Physics III.1's definition (STMT-BEING-MOVED-IS-ACTUALIZATION-OF-POTENCY) with the same `MovedIn` as STMT-NOTHING-MOVED-EXCEPT-AS-IN-POTENCY. Aristotle states the definition for physical change; applied to the broad reading it is the definition extended to every reduction from potency to act, and the bridge carries his support to the premise only as far as that extension holds. Moving as an end (#352): Met. XII.7's unmoved mover moves as an object of love (ὡς ἐρώμενον, 1072b3; In Metaph. XII, lect. 7 n. 1-3, sicut desiderabile, the heaven's motion being for its sake and caused by a proximate mover). The Lambda.7 readings (STMT-SOME-UNMOVED-MOVER-CANNOT-BE-OTHERWISE, STMT-EVERY-UNMOVED-MOVER-CANNOT-BE-OTHERWISE) read the case's MovesIn to include moving as an end: on the broad reading, what moves as an end is that for whose sake a potency is reduced to act. This is an unattributed reading choice, not a claim that Aristotle's mover is an efficient mover. ARIST-MET-XII-7-FIRST-MOVER-PURE-ACT depends on it: its uniqueness step identifies the prima via's first mover with Lambda.7's mover through the same MovesIn. If MovesIn is read as efficient moving only, the Lambda.7 mover need not satisfy IsFirstUnmovedMover and the step fails. Lambda.7's 'unmoved' and 'in no way otherwise' are read over the respects of change (DEF-RESPECT-OF-CHANGE); their extension to every respect, for a mover that moves something and is unmoved and unable to be otherwise in every respect of change, is the unattributed STMT-UNCHANGEABLE-IN-RESPECTS-OF-CHANGE-IS-UNCHANGEABLE-SIMPLY.

Existing resolution retained: `MoreIn esse` is one primitive comparative in every result; this record says which order model each use takes. Their order shapes need not differ: when every represented being has the perfection (`∀ x, InAct x r`), an order by approach to a primary is a homogeneous scale for the preorder pulled back along `near` (`ApproachToPrimaryReading.homogeneousLift`). Universal possession is an additional condition: the attribution reading itself requires only the primary to have the perfection. Strict primacy of one distinguished being (DEF-STRICT-PRIMACY) and the causal clause of q.13 a.5 are further separate premises. Aquinas' sense is the attribution order (q.3 a.5 ad 2, AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A5-AD2-APPROACH-ORDER-A), which attributes only the order by approach. Strict primacy is not attributed to q.3 a.5 ad 2: it is the separate open premise STMT-NOTHING-ELSE-REACHES-THE-PRIMARY, with no claim, taken as an explicit hypothesis where it is load-bearing (QUARTA-VIA-ATTRIBUTION-GENUS-PRINCIPLE-AT-BEING, QUARTA-VIA-ATTRIBUTION-UNIQUE-MAXIMUM). Likewise q.13 a.5 speaks of creatures; that everything other than the primary is a creature is the open premise STMT-OTHERS-THAN-PRIMARY-ARE-CREATURES. Verdicts on the frontier premises: (1) STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS: on the homogeneous scale the order gives it no support but is consistent with it (STMT-HOMOGENEOUS-SCALE-GIVES-NO-CAUSE-OF-BEING); on the attribution order its instance at being is derived from the order by approach, strict primacy, the causal order of creatures to the primary and the creature premise (STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-BEINGS), so at being it survives re-read as a consequence of q.3 a.5 ad 2 and q.13 a.5 plus two open metaphysical premises and excluded middle, while the principle for other perfections stays open. (2) STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH: its source sense is synonymous (Met. II.1, 993b24-26: the synonymous quality), the univocal sense, where it is consistent but unsupported; on the attribution order with strict primacy it holds for the primary as cause and fails in general (STMT-ATTRIBUTION-ORDER-RESTRICTS-CAUSE-MORE-SUCH). It therefore needs re-reading at being: restricted to the primary it is derivable, and the AT-MOST-ONE route uses it only there; applied with the primary as effect (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-FIRST-MOVER-IS-FIRST-BEING) it is neither derivable on the attribution order nor available in its synonymous sense, since q.13 a.5 (arg. 1 and ad 1) denies that the first agent is a univocal cause; that use equivocates unless separately sourced. (3) STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-IS-FIRST-BEING: neither order yields it, even with the causal order and STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING (STMT-ORDER-READINGS-DO-NOT-YIELD-FIRST-BEING). On the attribution order with strict primacy the maximum is the primary, so the bridge reduces to: nothing other than the primary is simply prior to it; it stays open.

Existing resolution retained: Three different uses share the words 'per se': a per se ordered series (prima via, `MovesAsMoved`), being necessary per se (tertia via, `IsNecessaryPerSe`: no cause of necessity from elsewhere), and being self-evident (per se notum; in this corpus the `self_evident` marking). Each is its own predicate or record field and no inference moves between them: the convergence result TERTIA-VIA-NECESSARY-PER-SE-IS-MAXIME-ENS uses only `IsNecessaryPerSe`, and the self-evidence of STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE rests on Aristotle's elenctic defence, not on per se ordering. The natural-law per-se-nota reading is Aquinas’s predicate-in-the-subject account of self-evidence. A claim proposing this account is not already a corpus self_evident marking.

Existing resolution retained: The case uses the strong reading. Result AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-STRONG-READING-INTENDED argues that it is Thomas' meaning (from the unrestricted conclusion, the wording, and the failure of the weak reading to yield an unmoved mover, under a stated charity principle); result AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-PRIMA-VIA-RELATIVE records that the weak reading yields only a mover unmoved as mover of its series; the irrelevant-respect objection is scoped by AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-IRRELEVANT-RESPECT-OBJECTION-SCOPE. Existing resolution retained: Every quantified God in the Q11 proof is an original IsGod instance in Being: a hypothetical divine being, not Father, Son or Spirit as distinct persons. suppositumOf is used here for the individuating basis in the anti-plurality argument and not as a divine-person index. The common deity parameter does not identify persons. Existing IsGod is not redefined and no Trinitarian conclusion follows.

Existing resolution retained: suppositumOf represents the individuating basis of this individual; essenceOf represents what the being is. Both take values in Principle only to permit the separately stated identity comparison. No identity between these senses, no injectivity, and no mapping of every immaterial being to one nature is assumed by the vocabulary. God-specific identity and common-nature scope are separate sourced open premises. This is unrelated to modal Scott/Gödel essence.

Existing resolution retained: The quarta via's 'true' is the truth of things (the respect `verum`), not the truth of sentences; no result links `verum` with `Holds`. The problem-of-evil results use truth of sentences. POE-EXTERNAL-PREMISE-VS-EMOTIVISM uses O'Connor's own notion (DEF-TRUTH-VALUE): moral statements are not the kind of sentence that can be true or false, so they are not true. That is the robust sense, and the result holds against his emotivism as he states it. It does not hold against an expressivist who grants moral sentences minimal truth: such a theorist rejects STMT-MORAL-STATEMENTS-LACK-TRUTH-VALUE in the minimal sense, and answering that rival is the open work of #182 and #185. 'Objectively true' (DEF-OBJECTIVE-TRUTH) is truth independent of attitudes; the result's conclusion denies truth simply, and it denies objective truth only under the further, unformalized bridge that what is objectively true is true (no Lean declaration states it). 'Catholicism is true' (DEF-CATHOLICISM-TRUE-PHASE-1) is the plain conjunction of its two conditions, not a further truth predicate. The objective-truth pilot uses DEF-LEAN-PROPOSITION-HOLDING for ∃ P : Prop, P and its logical counterpart: a proof in the encoded logic, not an identification with ontological, robust, minimal or attitude-independent truth. Its profile Interpretation is a stipulated external mapping, and a bridge preserving a logical sentence across profiles remains explicit and open.
